arxiv-1412-0118.title: Reissner-Nordstrom black hole in dark energy background
arxiv-1412-0118.description: Abstract In this paper we propose a stationary solution of Einstein’s field equations describing Reissner-Nordstrom black hole in dark energy background. It is to be regarded as the Reissner-Nordstrom black hole is embedded into the dark energy solution producing Reissner-Nordstrom-dark energy black hole.

arxiv-2101-12735.title: A discovery of a low-energy excess in cosmic-ray iron: an evidence of the past supernova activity in the Local Bubble
arxiv-2101-12735.creator: M. J. Boschini, S. Della Torre, M. Gervasi, D. Grandi, G. Jóhannesson, G. La Vacca, N. Masi, I. V. Moskalenko, S. Pensotti, T. A. Porter, L. Quadrani, P. G. Rancoita, D. Rozza, M. Tacconi
arxiv-2101-12735.description: Abstract Since its launch, the Alpha Magnetic Spectrometer – 02 (AMS-02) has delivered outstanding quality measurements of the spectra of cosmic-ray (CR) species, p ¯ \bar{p} , e ± e^{\pm} , and nuclei, 1 H– 8 O, 10 Ne, 12 Mg, 14 Si, which resulted in a number of breakthroughs.

arxiv-2111-00511.title: Optimal Targeted Advertising Strategy For Secure Wireless Edge Metaverse
arxiv-2111-00511.creator: Hongyang Du, Dusit Niyato, Jiawen Kang, Dong In Kim, Chunyan Miao
arxiv-2111-00511.description: Abstract Recently, Metaverse has attracted increasing attention from both industry and academia, because of the significant potential to integrate real and digital worlds ever more seamlessly. By combining advanced wireless communications, edge computing and virtual reality (VR) technologies into Metaverse, a multidimensional, intelligent and powerful wireless edge Metaverse is created for future human society.

arxiv-2307-01076.title: Analyzing Multiple-Choice Reading and Listening Comprehension Tests
arxiv-2307-01076.creator: Vatsal Raina, Adian Liusie, Mark Gales
arxiv-2307-01076.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Vatsal Raina, Adian Liusie, Mark Gales. Multiple-choice reading and listening comprehension tests are an important part of language assessment. Content creators for standard educational tests need to carefully curate questions that assess the comprehension abilities of candidates taking the tests. However, recent work has shown that a large number of questions in general multiple-choice reading comprehension datasets can be answered without comprehension, by leveraging world knowledge instead.

arxiv-2505-23847.title: Seven Security Challenges in Cross-domain Multi-agent LLM Systems
arxiv-2505-23847.creator: Ronny Ko, Jiseong Jeong, Shuyuan Zheng, Chuan Xiao, Tae-Wan Kim, Makoto Onizuka, Won-Yong Shin
arxiv-2505-23847.description: Abstract Large language models are evolving into autonomous agents that collaborate across organizations for tasks like disaster response and supply-chain optimization. However, such cooperation breaks unified trust assumptions: a benign agent may leak secrets or violate policy when interacting with untrusted peers.

arxiv-2510-27214.title: AGN–Host Galaxy Image Decomposition with JWST: Limitations of Sérsic Profile Models Journal: PASP Facilities: HST (ACS, WFC3), JWST (NIRCam) AstroPhot ( C. J. Stone et al. 2023 ) , astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) ,
arxiv-2510-27214.creator: Callum Dewsnap, Pauline Barmby, Sarah C. Gallagher
arxiv-2510-27214.description: Abstract The ability to disentangle the light of an AGN from its host galaxy is strongly dependent on the spatial resolution and depth of the imaging. As the capabilities of imaging systems improve with time, confirming that our standard techniques adequately model the increasingly complex structures unveiled is essential.

pmc-10641027.title: Transforming Medical Paradigms: A Cutting-Edge Review of Genomic and Robotic Medical and Surgical Approaches in the Battle Against Diabetes, Hypertension, and Cardiovascular Issues
pmc-10641027.creator: Yousaf Tanveer, Sailakshmn Sanipini, Rafeef Khleif, Tamar Tsenteradze, Abubakar Gapizov, Han Grezenko, Maryam Affaf, Ali M Abdelaziz, Abdur Rehman, Umar Zia, Huda Jama, Abdullah Shehryar, Syed Naveed Mohsin, Chukwuyem Ekhator, Rehman Khan
pmc-10641027.description: This article provides an in-depth review of the current state of management for diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease, focusing on advancements from genomics to robotics. It explores the role of genomic markers in personalized medicine, offering tailored treatment options for these chronic conditions.

pmc-10672362.title: Domain-Aware Few-Shot Learning for Optical Coherence Tomography Noise Reduction
pmc-10672362.creator: Deborah Pereg, Christos Chrysoulas
pmc-10672362.description: Speckle noise has long been an extensively studied problem in medical imaging. In recent years, there have been significant advances in leveraging deep learning methods for noise reduction. Nevertheless, adaptation of supervised learning models to unseen domains remains a challenging problem.

pmc-10712815.title: Female couples undergoing assisted reproduction - choices and the importance of pregnancy and genetics
pmc-10712815.creator: Pedro Brandão, Nathan Ceschin, Bodil Sandvik, Stefania Paolelli, Jakob Doblinger, Sérgio Reis-Soares, Ricardo Sousa-Santos, José Bellver
pmc-10712815.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate female couples’ reproductive choices, the importance given to genetics and pregnancy and their expectations regarding mother-child relationship.MethodsObservational study based on an anonymous survey applied to 217 patients during 2021. The survey was given to female couples under reproductive treatment in a private fertility clinic.

pmc-11435423.title: Intakes of Lean Proteins and Processed Meats and Differences in Mental Health between Rural and Metro Adults 50 Years and Older
pmc-11435423.creator: Nathaniel R Johnson, Sherri N Stastny, Julie Garden-Robinson, Lidia Markiewicz
pmc-11435423.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Mental health disparities exist between rural and metro areas of the United States. Differences in dietary intake may contribute to these disparities. We examined differences in dietary intake and mental health between those 50 years and older (n = 637) living in rural counties to those living in metro counties in North Dakota and the relationship between dietary intake to days with depression or anxiety. A survey was conducted throughout North Dakota.

pmc-12613545.title: The landscape of dynamic tumor immunophenotyping on neoadjuvant chemotherapy combined with trastuzumab for the treatment of HER2-positive breast cancer
pmc-12613545.creator: Hongtao Jin, Yaru Yang, Changjian Yan, Mei Liu, Xue He, Dan Yuan, Wei Zhang, Yunqing Mu, Chaoling Wu, Xiaoni Liu, Jinyuan Xiao, Qizhao Long, Min Li, Xiaoyu Hao, Yuqi Zhang, Wenxin Qi, Yan Liu, Zining Yu, Dan Guo, Zijian Zhao, Yanzhao Li, Weilong Zhang, Xiuru Zhang
pmc-12613545.description: BackgroundFor HER2-positive breast cancer (BC), patients who achieve pathologic complete response (pCR) are predicted to have better clinical outcomes. With the advent of the era of neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) combined with targeted therapy, the pCR rate of HER2-positive BC has increased significantly, but about 50% of these patients still do not respond to targeted therapy.

pmc-12644848.title: Characteristics and causes of regional differentiation of ecosystem services supply and demand in Sichuan Province, China
pmc-12644848.creator: Xinzhuo Fang, Fanni Ye
pmc-12644848.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Ecosystem services significantly impact human well-being and regional sustainable development, and clarifying the spatially heterogeneous characteristics of their supply and demand and the factors influencing them is the key to implementing sustainable development strategies.

pmc-12818902.title: Potentiation of noncanonical NF-κB signaling and marginal zone B cell expansion by CARD11-mediated regulation of p100 processing
pmc-12818902.creator: Anushka Ghosh, Tyler A Jones, Sophie Mackinnon, Shelby M Hutcherson, Julia M Tritapoe, Piyusha Mongia, Neha Shah, Emma M Mehlhop, Nicole M Carter, Joel L Pomerantz
pmc-12818902.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SUMMARYThe signaling scaffold CARD11 is critical for adaptive immunity and antigen receptor signaling to canonical nuclear factor κB (NF-κB), mTOR, JNK, and AKT. Oncogenic gain-of-function (GoF) CARD11 mutants, implicated in a variety of lymphomas, bypass regulation and signal constitutively. In mice expressing the lymphoma-associated mutation CARD11 C49Y, we observe B cell expansion that is most impressive for marginal zone (MZ) B cells.

pmc-13231834.creator: Daniel A. Mokhtari, Ali Lashkaripour, Polly M. Fordyce

pmc-13258787.title: Immune Dysregulation After COVID-19: Longitudinal Analysis up to 9 Months
pmc-13258787.creator: Paweł Mitkowski, Monika Leśniak, Dagmara Kobza, Karolina Aleksandrowicz, Aleksander Chodowiec, Krzysztof Piwowarek, Wojciech Włodarczyk, Klaudia Porębska, Katarzyna Plewka-Barcik, Agata Borkowska, Renata Rożyńska, Ewa Pietruszka-Wałęka, Andrzej Wojtyszek, Karina Jahnz-Różyk, Marcin Pękalski, Andrzej
pmc-13258787.description: SARS-CoV-2 infection triggers a strong inflammatory response, and persistent symptoms after recovery are thought to reflect prolonged systemic dysregulation. However, mechanisms underlying long COVID remain unclear. This study evaluated longitudinal changes in cytokine hematological and biochemical parameters up to nine months after hospitalization for COVID-19 and examined their relationship with persistent symptoms, vaccination status, and the occurrence of comorbidities.

pmc-13419254.title: Exploring the disease burden and quality of life in patients with short bowel syndrome with intestinal failure: Insights from exit interviews in the glepaglutide EASE SBS‐1 phase 3 trial
pmc-13419254.creator: David F. Mercer, Constance Mubekapi‐Musadaidzwa, Bitten Kloster, Mark Berner‐Hansen, Anna Rydén, Palle Bekker Jeppesen
pmc-13419254.description: BackgroundA randomized, double‐blind, placebo‐controlled trial was conducted to evaluate efficacy and safety of glepaglutide in patients who have short bowel syndrome with intestinal failure (SBS‐IF). At the end of the trial, exit interviews were conducted to explore participants' experiences and to assess the impact of the disease and treatment during the trial.

pmc-13427822.title: Experimental vibration time-series data for rotor crack detection and condition monitoring
pmc-13427822.creator: Maria Jesus Gomez Garcia, Cristina Castejon, Higinio Rubio, Juan Carlos Garcia-Prada
pmc-13427822.description: Condition monitoring and fault diagnosis in rotating machinery require high-quality datasets that capture the progressive evolution of structural defects under controlled conditions. This paper presents a comprehensive dataset acquired using SpectraQuest MFS-Lite, designed to study the dynamic behavior of rotating shafts with transverse cracks.

pmc-13686289.title: Analysis of the evolution of public policies and strategies for eliminating vertical transmission of the human immunodeficiency virus: a narrative review, Brazil, 1985-2025
pmc-13686289.creator: Andréa Mônica Brandão Beber, Katia Cristina Bassichetto, Francisca Lidiane Sampaio Freitas, Ximena Pamela Díaz Bermúdez, Elisangela da Silva, Lino Neves da Silveira, Leila Posenato Garcia, Adele Schwartz Benzaken, Andréa Mônica Brandão Beber, Katia Cristina Bassichetto, Francisca Lidiane Sampaio Fre
pmc-13686289.description: Objective To analyze the evolution of Brazilian public health policies and strategies aimed at eliminating vertical transmission of the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), the contribution of these policies to the reduction of AIDS cases among children under 5 years old, and the challenges to achieving the global elimination goals by 2030.

uslaw-usc-t26-s7806.description: United States Code, Title 26 (Internal Revenue Code); Chapter 80 (General Rules); Subchapter A (Application Of Internal Revenue Laws). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Cross references The cross references in this title to other portions of the title, or other provisions of law, where the word “see” is used, are made only for convenience, and shall be given no legal effect.
